verdict.rationale: stagewise documents running multiple agent instances in parallel, each with its own chat session and optionally a different model. That covers the 'run several attempts in parallel' half of the story. Diff review lets you accept or reject agent edits, but nothing shows attempts being isolated from each other or compared side by side before you pick a winner. Missing for 10: isolated per-attempt workspaces/branches, a side-by-side comparison of competing attempts, a select-one-and-discard-others workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one

citations.quote: stagewise supports multiple agent instances running in parallel. Each agent has its own chat session and can use a different model.
Accept, reject, or undo every agent edit with full inline diffs
